facts: IA is the abbreviation for Interval Algebra.
RCC is the abbreviation for Region Connection Calculus.
RCC-8 is a subset of the Region Connection Calculus (RCC).
Interval Algebra is a dominant Artificial Intelligence approach for representing and reasoning about qualitative temporal relations.
RCC-8 is a dominant Artificial Intelligence approach for representing and reasoning about qualitative topological relations.
Qualitative information can be formulated as a Qualitative Constraint Network.
QCN is the abbreviation for Qualitative Constraint Network.
The paper focuses on the minimal labeling problem.
MLP is the abbreviation for minimal labeling problem.
The paper proposes an algorithm to efficiently derive all the feasible base relations of a QCN.
◆ G-consistency is a new form of partial consistency.
The proposed algorithm uses tractable subclasses of relations.
The tractable subclasses of relations have a specific patchwork property.
entities: representing and reasoning about qualitative temporal and topological relations
